parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation or facility ban, and courts demonstrably work for trans people—compensation orders, Pride-ban reversal, 2019 prison HRT/transfer order, and hate-crime enhancement—with large-scale public acceptance. Against this, traveler-facing exposures are documented: airport gender-identity screening with humiliating questioning/detention and surgery demanded in 2023, with no airport regulation for trans travelers; custody default is isolation/segregation rather than gender-congruent placement, with no placement statute and visitor access to case-by-case relief unestablished; and 2025 data show rising homophobic/transphobic violence including dating-app ambushes, though raw counts lack a denominator. These are recurring state/societal exposures without proven correction at the border or in custody, placing it in elevated risk despite strong legal climate.
